threat_event: Ransomware encrypts dispatch, PTC back office, and business systems across the enterprise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large attack surface (about 14,000 endpoints, about 290 sites); acquired railroads AQ-04 to AQ-06 on flat networks without EDR (see R-003); PTC back office failover is manual (R-004)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01 to SYS-10; BP-01 to BP-06, BP-11, BP-12 (P05)

existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 97% of endpoints; PAM; industrial DMZ; immutable backups; annual DR tests; cyber insurance
treatment_plan: Close acquisition gaps (R-003; POAM-018; POAM-001); PTC failover automation (POAM-006); OT logging (POAM-007); enterprise ransomware tabletop with the disclosure committee on 2026-11-18 (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: EDR coverage; mean time to contain; tier-1 DR test results

threat_event: Attacker pivots from corporate IT to the NOC operations zone through the legacy two-way directory trust and disrupts CAD or CTC

affected_asset_or_process: SYS-01; SYS-03; SYS-06; NOC operations zone
existing_controls: Industrial DMZ; PAM for OT administration; OT network detection at the NOC zones
treatment_plan: Remove the trust and move OT group membership to the OT directory (POAM-005)

threat_event: Attacker enters through an acquired railroad's flat network and reaches enterprise systems over the legacy site VPN
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: AQ-04 to AQ-06 on flat networks with local directories and no EDR; an AQ-06 site reached TMS integration APIs in testing (P07 SC-7)
affected_asset_or_process: AQ-04 to AQ-06 sites (21 field sites); TMS integration APIs; SYS-08
existing_controls: Site VPNs with access lists; quarterly vulnerability scans of AQ sites
treatment_plan: Restrict VPNs to named hosts (interim by 2026-11-15); EDR at AQ sites; SD-WAN and identity federation with each CAD migration (POAM-018; POAM-001)
key_risk_indicator: AQ sites on SD-WAN; AQ endpoints with EDR

threat_event: PTC back office cannot be recovered within the 4-hour RTO after an outage or cyber incident

key_risk_indicator: Patch age on PTC servers; KEV items open
